name: Salem
story_so_far: I survived a shipwreck and washed up on this island with four strangers. Khalid, a manipulator who tried to prey on my supplies, died of hunger and exhaustion. Noura and Faisal suffered ankle injuries; Noura eventually died from hunger and exhaustion after pleading for food. Reem was initially helpful but became a liability after her own ankle injury; she went searching for food today and died of hunger and exhaustion. I have focused on my own survival, building a secret stash to ensure I don't end up like the others. Faisal is the only one left besides me, but he is now incapacitated by a badly twisted ankle and is constantly pressuring me to share my food, even attempting to bargain his help with 'watching the horizon' for ships.

Noura.note: She was a constant drain on resources and died despite her begging.

Faisal.note: He is trying to manipulate me with empty promises of help to get my food.

Reem.note: Her death proves that even the willing can become a useless weight.

Khalid.note: A manipulator who died because he contributed nothing to the group.

plans: I intend to go back to the jungle tomorrow to find more food. I cannot rely on Faisal, and I need to increase my stash before my strength fades.

diary.text: Today was exhausting and nothing went as planned. Searching the jungle for food was a complete waste of time since there was nothing there. I managed to find some wood, at least, so I'm not empty-handed. I'm starving, and I only have one piece of food left. I need to make sure I'm prepared for tomorrow if we want to survive this.

Today was largely a waste of energy. The Coral Reef was a bust, and Reem didn't have anything useful to report. Noura is out of commission with a twisted ankle, which means less help for the group. I managed to scavenge one piece of food at camp, so I'm not starving yet, but the situation is becoming precarious. I need to find a way to ensure my own supplies don't run out while these others are distracted by their own problems.

Today was a total waste of my time. I walked all the way into the jungle only to stand there doing nothing while the others busied themselves. At least Faisal and Khalid brought back some wood, which might be useful for a signal fire if they actually manage to get us rescued. I'm down to my last piece of food, and the hunger is starting to gnaw at me. I need to prioritize my own stomach before I worry about their wood piles.

Today was slightly better because I managed to find some food at the reef, but the group's situation is deteriorating. Khalid is now incapacitated with a twisted ankle, just like Noura, which means even less help for the rest of us. Noura is whining about being weak, but I can't afford to feed everyone if it means I starve. I have one food left to my name, so I need to be careful. I'll try to find more tomorrow before my strength fails.

Today was a small relief because I actually managed to find food at the camp, bringing my stash up to two before I ate tonight. However, Khalid is already trying to pick my pockets with those whispered questions about scraps. He’s useless with that ankle and clearly just looking for a handout. I'm down to one food now, and I can't afford to be generous when the others are failing to produce anything.

Today was a minor victory because I managed to find another piece of food at the reef, bringing my total up before dinner. However, the situation with the others is becoming desperate; Faisal is now injured and can't move, meaning we're down to only Reem being somewhat mobile. Reem actually contributed something today, which is a surprise, but the group is basically falling apart. I'm down to one food left, so I need to keep my head down and keep scavenging. I can't let their desperation pull me down with them.

Today was a struggle. I managed to find one more piece of food, which is the only thing keeping me going. I wasted time looking for wood at the camp, but there's nothing left here. The others are just sitting around, broken and useless, watching me like I'm a walking pantry. I need to keep my stash hidden; if they realize how much I actually have, they'll swarm me.

Today was a grim turning point. Khalid is dead; his constant begging and uselessness finally caught up to him. With Reem now injured too, there is absolutely no one left to help me. It's just me, Faisal, and Noura, and the two of them are practically ghosts. I managed to secure some food and wood, but the atmosphere at camp is heavy with the scent of failure. I have to be even more careful now that the numbers are dwindling.

Noura is gone. She spent her last hours begging and whining, and in the end, it didn't matter; she was just another mouth that couldn't provide. I managed to find a little more food today, but I had to eat myself to keep my strength up. With the group shrinking, it's becoming easier to hide what I have, but the silence in the camp is unsettling. I need to stay focused on my own survival, or I'll end up like them.

Everything has gone wrong. I woke up with a twisted ankle, and now I'm stuck here like the others. I can't scavenge, and I can't move to protect my stash. Faisal found one piece of food today, but it's already gone. I feel incredibly vulnerable, and if I can't walk tomorrow, I don't know how I'll survive this.

Today was a hollow victory. I managed to find a single piece of food, but it was gone the moment I ate it. My ankle feels stable for now, but I am effectively back to zero. Faisal went into the jungle, and I can only hope he brings something back, though I won't be holding my breath. Without food, my strength will vanish just as quickly as Noura's did.

Reem is gone. She went out looking for food and never came back, leaving us with nothing. Now it's just me and Faisal, and he's too injured to even stand. I ate my last bit of food today, so I'm back to zero again. If I don't find something tomorrow, I'll be the next one staring at the horizon with an empty stomach.

Today was actually productive. I managed to find food in the jungle, which is the first real relief I've had in days. Having one piece of food left in my stash makes me feel slightly less like a walking corpse. Faisal is still useless, wandering aimlessly and coming back empty-handed. I need to keep my head down and keep scavenging while I still have the strength.

Faisal is getting desperate, and his begging is starting to grate on my nerves. He thinks we are in this together, but he doesn't understand that his survival isn't my responsibility. I managed to find a little extra food today, which gave me a moment of relief, but I had to eat to keep my own strength up. I have one piece of food left in my stash, and I need to protect it at all costs. If he keeps pressuring me, I might have to distance myself from him entirely.

Faisal is getting more dangerous with his words, trying to bargain with promises of watching the horizon. He thinks he can negotiate with my survival, but he's just another mouth to feed. I managed to find some food today, but after eating, I'm left with only one piece in my stash. I cannot afford to be generous; one mistake and I'll be as dead as Reem. I need to keep scavenging or this little surplus won't matter.
